mapper.update: UPDATE sys_menu SET parent_id=#{menu.parentId}, type=#{menu.type}, name=#{menu.name}, route_key=#{menu.routeKey}, path=#{menu.path}, icon_key=#{menu.iconKey}, required_permission_code=#{menu.requiredPermissionCode}, sort_order=#{menu.sortOrder}, visible=#{menu.visible}, status=#{menu.status}, deleted=#{menu.deleted}, version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by=#{menu.updatedBy} WHERE id=#{menu.id} AND version=#{menu.version} AND deleted=FALSE
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_menu WHERE id=#{id} UNION SELECT m.id FROM sys_menu m JOIN subtree s ON m.parent_id=s.id WHERE m.deleted=FALSE ) SELECT u.* FROM sys_user u WHERE u.deleted=FALSE AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.deleted=FALSE JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id=r.id AND rm.deleted=FALSE JOIN subtree s ON s.id=rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id=u.id AND ur.deleted=FALSE ) ORDER BY u.id FOR UPDATE
